instructions: Pick the 3 that matter most to you right now — not the 3 that sound best.

cards.label: Security
cards.description: Stability you can plan around — for you and the people who depend on you.

cards.label: Craftsmanship
cards.description: Doing the work itself well, not just getting it done.

cards.label: Family
cards.description: Time and presence for the people closest to you.

cards.label: Independence
cards.description: Answering to your own judgment, not someone else's.

cards.label: Growth
cards.description: Becoming more capable — as an owner and as a person.

cards.label: Integrity
cards.description: Doing what you said you'd do, especially when no one's checking.

cards.label: Adventure
cards.description: Taking real risks and seeing what you're capable of.

cards.label: Recognition
cards.description: Being seen and respected for what you've built.

cards.label: Service
cards.description: Making a real difference for your customers or community.

cards.label: Mastery
cards.description: Getting genuinely excellent at the thing you do.

cards.label: Legacy
cards.description: Building something that outlasts your daily involvement.

cards.label: Connection
cards.description: Real relationships with your team, customers, and peers.

cards.label: Health
cards.description: Protecting the energy and body the business runs on.

cards.label: Adaptability
cards.description: Staying light on your feet as things change.
